nom: Acure Brightening Facial Scrub - Exfoliating Face Wash - 4 fl oz

avis.texte: I really like this facial scrub because it exfoliates without feeling overly harsh or abrasive on the skin. Some scrubs feel like you’re sanding a piece of furniture 😂, but this one feels gentle while still leaving your skin noticeably smoother. After using it, my skin feels silky soft, refreshed, and definitely looks brighter. It gives that clean, polished feeling without drying my face out. Such a nice addition to a skincare routine if you want a little glow boost without irritating your skin.

avis.titre: Buy it but don’t buy it all because I don’t wanna run out
avis.texte: When I tell you this scrub improved my skin in one use. I rarely leave reviews, I am not an influencer, and not aspiring to be, just an average girl crying into the mirror every day. I needed a scrub and stumbled upon this one. The price was great so I thought why not, I’ll try another product I’ll hate. Literally ONE wash with this and my face was noticeably so much softer and clearer. I could legitimately feel AND see the difference. Embarrassingly enough I also had some breakouts happening on my back, so I thought why not try it and once again ONE scrub down with this later and the breakouts are actually done the next day. Plus this is a cruelty-free brand which is VERY important to me. I will absolutely be purchasing this again and looking into their other products.

avis.titre: Fantastic quality and truly OutstandingFantastic quality and truly Outstanding
avis.texte: Finally, a scrub that delivers radiance without stripping my skin. I’ve been using Acure Brightening Facial Scrub for three weeks, and it’s become a staple in my morning routine. The texture is pleasantly gritty (thanks to the French green clay and sea kelp) but not harsh—it exfoliates dead cells without leaving redness. I focus on my T-zone and nose, and after rinsing, my skin feels smooth and looks noticeably more even-toned. The 4 fl oz bottle is compact for travel, and a pea-sized amount is enough for a full face. Pros: Gentle enough for daily use yet effective; rinses clean without residue; the subtle, natural scent is refreshing (no artificial perfume); leaves a healthy glow that lasts all day. Cons: The tube can get messy if you don’t squeeze carefully; it may be too mild for those needing heavy physical exfoliation. I would absolutely recommend this to anyone with normal, combination, or slightly dull skin looking for an affordable, gentle daily exfoliator. It doesn’t foam much, so it’s ideal if you prefer non-stripping cleansers. My skin has never looked brighter.

avis.titre: Wasn't too harsh for my sensitive skin.
avis.texte: I rarely exfoliate because my skins typically pretty soft, but every once in awhile it feels like it needs it. I was worried about trying this product because my skin is sensitive and I tend to break out easily, which I guess is another reason why I don't exfoliate it often. Anyway, I use the product as directed. My face immediately felt soft, fresh, and clean. To ensure my face didn't over dry afterwards, I applied CeraVe moisturizing cream and once that absorbed aquaphor to seal it in. I am very happy with the results and I will use this next time I need to exfoliate my face.

avis.titre: Great Product But Not For Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I enjoy this face scrub, although I will say it is a bit rough on skin so if you have sensitive skin, you might want to pass! It helps make my skin feel really clean though, and I use it twice a week!

avis.titre: Amazing for My Super Sensitive Skin!
avis.texte: I have extremely sensitive skin, so finding a face scrub that doesn’t leave my skin feeling irritated, dry, or uncomfortable can be really difficult. I honestly wasn’t expecting much from this one because it’s so affordable, but I’ve been genuinely impressed with it. After using it, my skin feels incredibly soft and smooth, and I love how clean and refreshed my face feels afterward. One of the biggest things I noticed is that my skin looks calmer and the redness seems much less noticeable after I use it. It exfoliates my skin well without feeling overly harsh, which is especially important for me because my skin reacts very easily to new products. I also really appreciate that I don’t have to spend a lot of money to get such good results. I’ve tried more expensive skincare products that I didn’t enjoy nearly as much as this one. It has definitely become one of those products I look forward to using in my skincare routine. If you have sensitive skin like me and struggle to find an affordable scrub that leaves your skin feeling smooth without making it feel irritated, I think this one is absolutely worth trying. I would genuinely repurchase this again and again!

avis.titre: Love the grit of this facial scrub
avis.texte: This ACURE brightening facial scrub has become one of my favorite facial scrubs, and honestly one of my favorite face washes in general. I'm the type of person who enjoys a bit of grit in my facial products, especially my cleansers, so this one fits right into my routine. I don't use it every single day, but a few times a week I like to follow up my oil cleanser with something with more texture, just so I can really feel that it's exfoliating and lifting away sebum and dead skin. This ACURE scrub delivers every time. The grit level feels just right to me and it hasn't caused any irritation so far, which matters a lot since my skin can be sensitive. I'm mindful that gritty scrubs can sometimes lead to micro tears if overused, so I space it out to every few days rather than daily, and that balance has worked really well for my skin. It's become a staple in our household, and I liked it enough that I've gotten friends to add this ACURE scrub to their own skincare routines too. My only real complaints are more about the packaging than the formula itself. I wish ACURE offered this scrub in a travel size because I'd love to bring it with me when I travel, but the consistency is thick enough that it doesn't transfer well into travel size bottles. The other small annoyance is that my bottle always seems to trap water and product between the lid and the bottle threads, no matter how quickly or carefully I close it, so I've learned to be cautious when opening it since there's usually s

avis.titre: Great for sensitive skin and daily useGreat for sensitive skin and daily use
avis.texte: I purchased this because I am in my early 30s and wanted something gentle, wasn’t going to chemically strip my skin, yet coarse enough to get all the dead skin off and allow my skin routine to work. This is amazing. I have sensitive skin, I am on weightloss meds and so scared for the flabby face that’s often portrayed while using these meds. This stuff is really making a difference. It’s pleasant to smell, slightly sweet but not artificial. A little goes a long way. It doesn’t breakdown when you have days you want to scrub your face off- it still holds integrity and is malleable. It doesn’t negatively interact with other skin care like retinol after. I can use this in the am after a deep night cream and/or at night after a long day at work. I’m on my 2nd bottle which is saying something. Also, I’m a bio female but I got the fuzzy gene, so if you struggle with unwanted hair, (and the issues therein) this is going to be a gentle game changer. I love that this product doesn’t hurt my face when I use it! If you have sensitive skin you know what I mean. It’s my go to every time I wash my face.

Ich war anfangs skeptisch weil ich schon seit Jahren so ein Peeling suche. Ich bin begeistert. Die guten Rezessionen sind wahr. Ein Peeling das wirklich peelt und das ohne Reizungen. Ich werde nur noch das kaufen und 💗 hoffe dass es immer so bleibt und nie geändert wird und immer verfügbar bleibt.

Actually I didnt know I was buying a scrub because the packaging is exactly the same as the cleansing gel. So I tried it for the first time but it turned out great. Very fine scrubbing and leaves a smooth after effect.

The ACURE Brightening Facial Scrub is a standout exfoliator designed to brighten and rejuvenate the skin. Formulated with natural ingredients like sea kelp and French green clay, this scrub effectively removes dead skin cells, unclogs pores, and promotes a smoother complexion. Its gentle, yet powerful, exfoliating action helps to reveal a refreshed, radiant skin tone without causing irritation. The 118ml size provides ample product for regular use, and the scrub's non-drying formula ensures that skin feels soft and hydrated post-application. Ideal for all skin types, especially dull or uneven skin, it is a great addition to your skincare routine for achieving a glowing, healthy-looking complexion. Overall, the ACURE Brightening Facial Scrub is a must-have for those seeking a natural, effective solution to brighten and exfoliate the skin.

I've been using the Acure Facial Scrub for about four years now, and after trying plenty of facial scrubs over the years, this one is still my favorite. They updated the packaging a couple of years ago, but in my opinion, the formula itself hasn't changed at all, which I was very happy about. It works just as well as it always has. I don't use it every day because it is a true exfoliating scrub and does its job well, but I use it about two to three times a week and never skip it before self-tanning. I use it on my face, down my neck, and across the top of my chest to make sure everything is smooth and prepped. The packaging is also great. I've never had issues with leaking, and the cap opens and closes easily without making a mess in the shower or travel bag. This has easily become my number one facial scrub, especially considering the price point. It performs as well as products that cost much more, and it's one of the few skincare products that I've consistently repurchased for years.

GLOWING!! THIS is the BEST face exfoliating scrub in the world!! I use every 3 days and have been for a few years and Im litterally looking younger than I did 5 years ago. Trust me!! This stuff with change your texture. Never ever going without!
My fellow millennials if you used St Ives to scrub off your face as a teenager…. This here takes the crown. I use chemical exfoliant twice a week and this once a week and I am loving it.

My skin looked instantly bright and I was glowing after the first use. The scrub is not abrasive and it does help with brightening my combination skin.

Love the product, new packaging SUCKS. I’ve used this for over a decade and never had ANY issue even being tossled and thrown around. A SOFT fall from the shower shelf and the soft plastic part split right open. Won’t process a return 😩
Holy Batman!! This is my new favorite exfoliating face wash. It smells like your being treated to a facial at the spa. It actually works 🥰

avis.titre: This brings a natural glow to your complexion!
avis.texte: This is a great exfoliation cleanser , it leaves your skin feeling soft, glowing and clean. I wouldn’t use daily , maybe once a week is ok, but I absolutely love this facial scrub.

avis.titre: Answer to my sensitive skin prayers!
avis.texte: I received a small trial bottle of this scrub in a kit and fell in love! I have always only been able to use regular dial antibacterial soap on my sensitive skin. I have combination (sometimes oily sometimes dry) skin depending on the weather. This scrub has changed my life! I use it every other day and it softens my skin and helps my skin appear more youthful! I started using this scrub after Christmas and people can NOT BELIEVE I am 35!! YES! they freak out when I tell them I am not 24! HAHA! Seriously, I hear it from everyone how young I look and how vibrant my skin is! It is all because of this scrub! My skin is no longer dull from harsh, chemical soaps. I tried EVERYTHING! Expensive washes and toners and moisturizers...you name it...I have tried it!! This is the only scrub that has not broken me out. I love it and I know you will too!!

I have been using the ACURE Brilliantly Brightening Facial Scrub for over 3 years. It is fantastically luxurious at a very affordable price. I scrub my face, neck, and upper chest area twice a week and the bottle easily last me 6 months. I usually pay $9 - $10 per bottle. - The green clay is smooth while the gritty parts are exfoliating without scratching. - I am overly sensitive to smells and this has a very light earthy/floral smell that I enjoy. - I choose to use it in the shower. Once I washed it off in the bath tub and had quite a tub ring to clean up! LOL - I will leave it on for a few minutes while working on "other things" in the shower. - It is never irritating or drying. - It is FREE of all those nasty chemicals I try to avoid. - ***It smells and feels like I am getting an expensive spa treatment.***

WOW this is unbelievably great! I am 56yrs and have bought and tried probably 50+ face products and most are unused and sitting in my bathroom cabinet! Not with this product. I used the gel cleanser with the matching scrub and day cream. What a difference in my skins health and overall look. I 100% can say that after using the cleanser and scrub my skin was so smooth and soft. I could not believe my skin felt like that again. I asked my husband to feel it I was so excited and he too said wow! The day cream is light in weight which I like. The smell is a light citrus fresh smell. It just ordered the face serum in the same line for brightening. Give it a try!

Results are immediate - I have been using this product for only 2 weeks and am already in love. If you can get past the color (deep green), the rest is amazing. Unlike less costly scrubs (ex. St. Ives Apricot Scrub), this one manages to be far more effective while feeling less abrasive due to smaller yet more polishing granules. Among its natural ingredients is French green clay, which gives skin a satiny soft finish. I use it every other day in the shower, massaging over wet skin for about a minute. Skin is immediately smoother and has a more even tone (this scrub has an excellent balance of acetic, calming, and polishing ingredients). This product stimulates circulation and has a refreshing ginger smell. The scrub is also vegan and not tested on animals. I am considering purchasing other Acure products because this one is so outstanding. Acure Brightening Facial Scrubs will make nice gifts for everyone (including men).

I had the same experience as others on here. The first product that I purchased was amazing I loved everything about it especially that it is more natural than other scrubs out there. Since I loved it so much I ordered a second and it was completely different from the first one. Right away the first difference is the packaging which I don't mind it but the product is completely different, it feels slimy on the face and I feel like it doesn't scrub well and also the product is harder to come out the bottle, I guess because it's thicker consistency? I wish the people who sell this could explain why, because it happened to alot others as well.
The packaging was different than pictured. The scrub is very abrasive and gritty, so use small amounts with care. Works great for my occasional need to slough off dry winter facial skin.

I was a but weary at first that the facial scrub might be too abrasive. However, I struggle with acne and build up due to dry and dead skin and I needed something a bit more abrasive than ny current exfoliate to add into my skin care routine. THIS IS IT! My face feels amazing after use - it was just enough abrasion without damage. Will keep using this several times per week as recommended.

So, I used to bake in the sun in the mid-70s to early 80s. Blisters on my cheeks (dimple on my right side) and I would be back out with baby oil. I have used botox twice when I was in the mid-30s but could not handle the pain. I attribute my lack on wrinkles on my face (I do have some crows feet on the side of my eyes and some bags under my eyes) to this exfoliant. I swear it takes off about 5 layers of skin. Anyway, I am sure wrinkles are in the not-too-distant-future but I thought I would share. Hey, no judging my skin for other reasons (spots, hair). I don't like waxing either so I dye my 'stache with Sally Hanson.

I LOVE this Facial Scrub. I normally don't write reviews but this is a must. I have been using it for 1 year now and it definitely works. I have told all my FB family & friends about this product. It definitely makes a difference in smoothness & appearance, especially if you have uneven skin tone and it fades away dark spots...These products are by far way cheaper than other nane brands and IT WORKS! Trust me I have tried alot of brands to clear up my face and this is the best. This is not a fake product or review. I have been using this exfoliating for months until it run out. I have no complaints, instead, i love this exfoliating. Old Acure: Fine sea salts texture, olive green New Acure: kind a rough and big, forest green-blue green. My big question is: did they change the formula? or I have to consider which one is fake?

avis.titre: Feeling like rubbing sand on my face
avis.texte: I feel like this facial scrub is a little bit too harsh on my face. The color also doesn’t look pleasant as well. The smell is not that bad as it contains natural ingredients. Also, it is little hard to spread the paste on my skin as it is dry as well even I tried to wet my face multiple times. After using it for 2 weeks, I didn’t see much of difference on my skin. On the other hand, it just hurts my skin every time i use it.

avis.titre: Terrible texture. STOP: has large sharp nut particles
avis.texte: How does a product like this even past the approval process? Reading it was a clay I was excited because I’m forever looking for super fine grain exfoliants having dry flaky skin but not wanting to scratch the skin surface. Wow was I wrong believing this to be a nice smooth clay texture. See pic..I smeared some on a plate. In fact it’s a runny watery mess with a slightly thickening emulsifier added. And then these big suuuper sharp scratchy exfoliants particles. I read the back and I was horrified to see it’s ground nut shells. What!? We all know you can’t do that! I am all for wanting to stay natural, but that’s the trick with exfoliants… Only certain fine clay products fit the bill of superfine exfoliation that minimizes microtears on the skin surface. Anything large like ground nuts in godforsaken drugstore brands that also crush up natural particles scratch the crap out of your skin! You can feel it! I was horrified when I tried this product and quickly rinsed it away. Not to mention the tube is cheap plastic… Arrived cracked at the edges near the pressed end. Even though the shipping box was in good shape. So it leaked within the bag and I lost some product. Amazon gave me a credit because of the leak since this item is not returnable. But I’m so unimpressed with the product it’s going in the trash.
How about not placing this label over the directions? I had to google the directions. Haven't used the product yet, so I'm not sure how effective it is.

Like the cleansing effect of the product and it lasts me a long time. BUT, I just became aware that this time the cap is damaged and I will not be able to seal it after each use as it has begun "tearing apart". If I had known, I would have requested a replacement before return timed out. Wish I could get a replacement for just the cap. Had I realized it was going to be this bad, I would have saved from emptied tube. Major Bummer. Gave over all rating of 3 stars due to packaging issue.

One of my absolute favorite face exfoliating scrubs! The consistency is very thick and effective & it hardly has a scent, almost like a clay smell really. I apply in the shower because it is much easier to wash off. Another thing I do sometimes is add a little bit of liquid face wash to the scrub to help it stay on my skin easier. Scrub by applying in a light circular motion. I immediately notice a improvement in skin tone and texture. I’ll continue to use this once a week. A bottle goes a long way, you only need a dime sized amount to cover your face. As you can see from my photo.

avis.titre: I really like this face scrub
avis.texte: I really like this face scrub, it's soft enough to use multiple times a week and isn't overly drying. It is a slightly different ingredient list/formula than before, but I still like this version (attached a photo both versions in case you're an ingredients checker! - old one on the left, new one on the right). I have combination skin that is prone to breakouts and this has helped me to keep my skin clear and bright. It isn't perfect, but it has been a considerably better than "acne" products.

avis.titre: Never using another brand of face scrub
avis.texte: Smells wonderful -like eating marzipan while sitting at the beach. The grit is very fine compared to St. Ives or other cheaper scrubs. This feels gentler and more appropriate for facial use. Also, as someone with sensitive skin, I appreciate the all natural, non-irritating ingredients. The dark green color is weird at first (sea kelp) but I use my face scrub in private anyway. So, not a big deal.

avis.titre: A serious scrub! update: a seriously BAD scrub
avis.texte: UPDATE: SO, what a roller coaster! The first tube I got was the most amazing scrub I’ve ever tried (see review below). It was a thick, sandy paste that had an immediate result. So naturally, I ordered another one. The next tube was COMPLETELY DIFFERENT!!!! Not only was it different, this time it was the WORST scrub I’ve ever used: oily, water, with larger pieces of like rock (think occasional pieces of sea salt). I’m not talking about a think, luscious, Himalayan exfoliation mix... I mean, imagine if I grabbed the sea salt from the kitchen cabinet, opened it, and poured 15 pieces into a spoon of green oil. It was the crappiest thing ever! I’m wondering if this is what other reviews were talking about when they mentioned liking the “old formula” better than the newest. I’m assuming my first tube I got lucky and got the old formula. To summarize, the newest version is utter crap. Totally devastated that the worlds greatest scrub no longer exists. Don’t waste your time or money. Old review from 1st tube I got: This was pretty impressive. This was like super fine sand paper. I honestly was expecting it to be a disappointment. My scrubs are typically 17$-28$. This is hands down the best scrub ever! In love over here!

This facial scrub is really fantastic! Works on all skin tone from most chocolate to milk skin tone! What can I say! However, the consistency of the 2nd tube wasn’t as good and that is the reason I gave it a 4 stars. The consistency was lumpy as if it was unstable. I didn’t return it cause….. I didn’t want to be bothered. So I’m trying of getting another tube. And if it doesn’t work well…. I won’t be purchasing it.

avis.titre: Bright ,Soft, and Glowing skin? Yes please!!

I love how a little goes a longgg way, Honestly you really don't need much (sorry if the picture looks gross🔎 just wanted to show the texture) I keep the tube in the shower and use about 3 times a week and my skin is unbelievably soft and best part is my make up applies much smoother!!

I’ve been using a lot of stuff for my face because I have mild acne and seeing the reviews I had to try this and first impression I had was amazing since my skin has became so dry, everything I apply on it burns even moisturizer and this scrub didnt burn and left my skin feeling super fresh 100% recommended!!

It's really interesting, the bottle is a nice size and unlike some of my other beauty Products, it didn't spill or break, which was really nice. I have only tried it once but what I first noticed was the color, it's a dark green and smelled kinda earthy. After using it didn't leave a residue or film on my skin and its smooth to the touch, I haven't seen any long term effects but from now, I think it is a good product.

avis.titre: Love the soap when it's right

Nice scrubbies, like the feel of the clay, and smell is good. There's clearly production consistency problems so I hope they get them fixed up b/c I do like the soap. The picture shows one dry and the goopy one side by side.

avis.titre: Definitely cleans and brightens your face

This is a fabulous scrub! I have very sensitive, acne prone skin. I am 39 years old and have also acquired some dark spots over the years. Not only had this scrub lightened the dark spots, but it has also cleared my skin immensely! You won’t go wrong with this scrub!

I am a first time user of this brand. At 47 I noticed my skin wasn't as smooth and my cheeks seemed to be breaking out. I decided to try this and I really do love it. I use it 5 days a week but I don't use a lot or scrub very hard. Sicnce i liked this brand I've ordered another product and like that as well.

I have ordered this twice, the first time the product was exactly as pictured (you can also find this at Sprouts and it was the same as that). Awesome! LOVE that one! avis.titre: First order great - second, not so much!
avis.texte: This is the second shipment of this product that I have purchased. The first product was great, but the second product is disappointing. The texture is now far more coarse and the product smells different. The packaging has changed as well. I suspect this product is now made in a different facility of inferior ingredients. I won’t purchase again. Giving 3 stars as it isn’t awful now, just not as good as before.

It definitely doesn't look so great or smell so great coming out of the tube, lol, but my skin loves it! The label says to use twice a week, but I have just started using it every other day. As you can see, from the picture, it is a very THICK formula and as "scrub" suggests, it has a really good texture to it that helps with exfoliating your skin. My skin looks and feels refreshed after this.

avis.titre: Refreshing facial scrub free from nasty chemicals
avis.texte: I have a bottle of this in my guest shower and the past three people who have visited both commented on this product AND purchased it online before they left my place! Pros Free of nasty chemicals; EWG Skin Deep rating of 1 Effective; Love how soft my skin feels after using this Refreshing Nice subtle smell Long lasting; A little goes a long way Cons None, so far

The change in packaging and product is incredibly apparent. It has lost that feeling of luxury on a budget and is now simply budget. The texture of the new formula is very grainy unlike the formula I have loved for so long. See the pics- original formula on the left, new on the right. I'm going to give it a try. Hoping it delivers the same results.

Great product, hit or miss on whether it will arrive usable. First bottle was awesome, ordered a second and it arrived split on both sides and leaking everywhere. Appears to be hit or miss whether or not that will be the case each time from other reviews.

avis.titre: It has a lot of grit like beach sand.
avis.texte: I ordered this Acure Brightening Facial Scrub to use as a daily face scrubber. I have oily skin and wanted a cleanser that got my skin practically squeaky clean by washing off all the oil. The Sea Kelp & French Green Clay smell nice, but it doesn't get my skin feeling as clean as I would like. My face feels like it has some moisturizer on it after washing. That might be good for some people, but it doesn't work for me. Also, this scrub has some grit! Don't push too hard while scrubbing. The first time I used it, I pushed too hard. It felt like I was scrubbing my face with wet beach sand. I will not purchase again.

avis.titre: I didn’t think it would work this well!
avis.texte: I was prescribed a topical medication for my rosacea, but it wasn’t until I added this scrub that my skin really started to look better! I received the ‘new’ formula, and it works great (:

avis.titre: I will keep buying this product
avis.texte: This is my third time purchasing this product because I really love it. It always leave my face feeling super smooth and soft. It does a great job exfoliating my face without it being too harsh. It also comes in a good size bottle that will last me over 2 months and I use it almost everyday.

avis.titre: Awesome! Feel so clean!! No micro-beads!!!!
avis.texte: Best facial exfoliate ever since the whole micro-beads problem. It is a natural exfoliate with a nice minty scent. My face felt so clean afterwards. Don't let the dark black color scare you. Totally worth it! I love it! And a little goes a long way! You only need to exfoliate 3 times a week! So I can wait to try their facial cleanser.
Love this. Have been using this product for about 3 weeks. Makes my face smooth and not sensitive afterwards. Same product as what I purchased before from Target prior.

avis.titre: What’s with the sticker on it?
avis.texte: Received product with that sticker on it with a QR code that doesn’t work and it says new. Called the Acure company and was told by them that they do not do that to their product so I don’t understand if this was returned or what, but as I am giving this as a gift it’s useless. It did not come from the company itself. it came from Amazon so I don’t get it. Also, you can’t return this.

I love this face scrub. Its very grainy but feels great like its really scrubbing deep into my pores. The color might throw you off if you're used to white and dyed products but I love that it's this way because of the natural ingredients it contains. This is my favorite facial scrub I've used so far and am currently on my second tube!

avis.titre: Great product in a poor container.
avis.texte: Love the natural light scrub! However, the lid doesn't close all the way! It doesn't do me any good if the product is all dried up. Thankfully my travel size Jergens lotion bottle has a close enough lid that it fits. I wish there was a way to just request a new lid.

This product did not work for me, please check the ingredients. The first pictures are right after three sprays. I wash my face imminently and it continue to get redder and redder, 15min later you can see how red my face got it took about two hours to calm down the heat however you still end up but with a burn red mark it doesn’t hurt me or anything but I can still see the red on my face. The last picture is 24 hours later. The label don’t give you any warnings of reactions or anything and it says you’ll end up with a refreshing feeling…
Just got this in and it’s cracked at the top! 👎🏼 The scrub seems to be a good scrub though. I will order again, just hope it doesn’t come in like it did today.

Used for the 1st time today and this one is a definite keeper. Left my skin feeling extremely soft and smooth. The color of the scrub is green but the smell is very subtle. A little goes a long way. Will purchase again for myself or give as a gift.
They changed the entire formula. It’s no longer a scrubbing exfoliant, just a gel

avis.titre: Not a fan of the color
avis.texte: The color of the wash itself reminds me of mud which I wasn’t a fan of. It’s gritty though so it definitely exfoliates well.

I have purchased this product before. The product is great; However, this bottle arrived damaged and with no protective cover over the cap, which is typical. Amazon says it's not eligible for return. I recommend this product, but I don't recommend purchasing it from Amazon.
This is my 2nd time buying this and I LIVE for it! Definitely brightens ur face making it feel Smooth! Highly recommend

The products arrived dirty and with stickers on them that are impossible to remove. And of course it isnt allowing me to return.

avis.titre: Horrible customer service with poor product
avis.texte: The product is rough on skin, causing rashes. There is no expiration date on product which is very concerning. Return is also not possible with this company, with no alternative of returning or replacement. Customer service was very uncooperative and disregarded all my concerns.

avis.titre: The sticker on the product is ridiculous
avis.texte: I received the product with a huge sticker on the back of the bottle that was difficult to get off and once removed had to buy adhesive remover to get all the sticky stuff off. Listen, if you need to sticker the item place it over a bag with the product inside. Or use an adhesive that is easy to remove. I’ll be back later to tell you how the product actually works. Stay tuned!! Update: the product leaves my face feeling super soft I use it twice a week and I’m a redhead with fair skin. No irritation whatsoever.
Incredible!! Just arrived and just used and am just floored! My skin is glowing!
The box that delivered the product looked fine but they sent a damaged product unfortunately.

I have never in my life experienced a reaction this badly from a product. I don't think I'm a person with sensitive skin but 20 seconds into using this scrub my face was on fire!!! It felt like someone had rubbed freshly cut chilies all over my face for 5-10 minutes. Really disappointed and I will not be using this again..

avis.titre: Damaged in shipping and can’t return.
avis.texte: Actually I like this product a lot. However, it is often damaged in shipping. It also cannot be returned. Therefore, I will be buying this from Target to ensure package integrity. In the attached picture, you can see where the tube splits at the top on both the face wash and scrub. The face wash leaked all over everything inside the box. I ordered both the scrub and face wash...both were damaged in shipping. Amazons customer service makes it impossible to describe what occurred in order to exchange it.

I actually love this product but this is the 2nd time I ordered where the top corners of the seams are busted and the product comes out of the top when you squeeze it out of the correct opening. I didn’t ask for help/replacement last time because I figured it was a one off. Now, I opened this for the first time 2 days ago and I squeeze. Comes out 3 different holes. Amazon and/or seller consider this item non-returnable or replaceable. If this isn’t fixed, I’ll get it elsewhere.
So the product is fine. But this sticker is ridiculous. First of all we store this in our shower. Don’t want a non-removable label on the tube. Second of all it covers the ingredients.

avis.titre: UNTRUSTWORTHY. Awful rebrand. Product + packaging inconsistencies!
avis.texte: Not sure which face wash is the real one!? I bought from the same seller on amazon. The one pictured on the right arrived broken and smells very strongly of perfume. The consistency of the two face washes are very different too. The one on the left is incredibly thick, pasty and dark green. The one pictured on the right is lighter in color, consistency is wetter & less thick. Completely disappointed and confused. I used to love the Brightening facial scrub from Accure before the rebrand. Not sure if it’s an untrustworthy seller on Amazon or Accure?
My face is so beautiful after using this I don't even need makeup clears up everything smoothed out all the pores and my face feels so clean i will use this stuff forever!
Love Love Love, not only does it feel like a proper scrub, but it has does wonders for my eczema!!! Have been looking for a great scrub for some time, i am a happy girl!

avis.titre: Much to harsh - ground walnut shells
avis.texte: The third ingredient is walnut shell and this isn’t clearly listed in the product description, never mind as the main exfoliant. I don’t have overly sensitive skin but this was much too harsh and scratched me.

I understand we’re in the middle of a pandemic and lots of things can’t be returned but the fact that I can’t get a refund either is a little ridiculous. avis.titre: Skin feels polished and is as smooth as baby skin

I’m super impressed and the price is just too good. I will definitely be using this regularly (prob 2 times a week). Do yourself a favor and try it out!!

The Acure Facial Scrub not only fulfills its purpose but also leaves my face feeling incredibly fresh and smooth, like butter, without the dryness I experienced from more abrasive scrubs in the past. avis.titre: Perfect if you want to tear your skin off (and false ingredient list)
avis.texte: Why this thing has so many great reviews, I will never know. First: the smell hit me and immediately made me want to gag. I thought, what does this smell remind me of? Oh yeah, the smell of my toddler son’s vomit after he ate too much candy for Halloween. I had to breathe thru my mouth so that I would stop gagging. Second: I started gently using this scrub, and was immediately surprised by how harsh it was. I was BARELY rubbing it into my skin, and I was surprised with how it felt like it was stripping my skin. I thought, there is NO WAY this product got so many great reviews. This will clearly cause some serious issues in your skin by over-stripping it…. And I realized it reminded me of something else… The dreaded St. Ives’ walnut scrub that I used as a teenager, that def stripped my skin so badly that my skin reacted by trying to “protect” by creating more oil, which then caused more and more acne over time. Third: I decided to double-check the ingredients list, and I was right!!! This damn product has walnut shells as #3 ingredient. The same main ingredient in the St. Ives’ that everyone now knows to stay away from. I would never have bought this item if I knew that walnut shells was in the top 3 ingredients. I normally check ALL ingredients of my skin care before I buy it, and so I went back on Amazon’s website And this brings me to Fourth: the ingredient list on the product in my hands IS DIFFERENT than what’s pictured online. Like WTF?? In what’s pictured, the walnut sh
There was a clear gel in this bottle. Scary to think what's in there!
bought 3 items and received them all open from the top! don't buy this product

avis.titre: Gentle, Effective, and Leaves Skin Glowing!
avis.texte: The Acure Brightening Facial Scrub has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. It delivers noticeable results without being harsh, making it perfect for anyone looking to achieve brighter, healthier-looking skin. Why It Stands Out Effective Exfoliation: The scrub uses natural ingredients like walnut shell powder and clay to gently exfoliate dead skin cells. After every use, my skin feels incredibly smooth and refreshed without any irritation or over-drying. Brightening Power: The inclusion of supergreens like kale and spinach, along with sea kelp, adds a boost of antioxidants that help brighten my complexion over time. After a few weeks, I noticed a visible glow and reduced dullness in my skin. Gentle Formula: Despite its exfoliating properties, the scrub is gentle enough for my sensitive skin. It’s free of parabens, sulfates, and other harsh chemicals, which is a big win for anyone mindful of clean skincare. Perfect Texture: The formula strikes the right balance—gritty enough to exfoliate effectively, but not so rough that it feels abrasive. Plus, the refreshing scent adds a spa-like touch to my routine. Packaging and Value The tube packaging is convenient and hygienic, ensuring you get just the right amount of product without waste. A little goes a long way, so the value for the price is excellent. Versatility While it’s marketed as a facial scrub, I’ve also used it on my neck and décolletage for extra exfoliation and brightening. It’s a versatile product that fits

avis.titre: Why didn’t I find and use this centuries ago?!!!
avis.texte: Well, better late than never, right?! I tried this Brightening Facial Scrub after centuries of just using anything to clean my face. At 55, I finally get it; you are what you eat, treat your skin like it means something and blah blah blah. I’m sure you know where I’m going…don’t think about getting this and trying it; just do it, you will not regret it! After the first use I was like, whoa, my face is clean and soft like when my babies were infants right out of the hospital and their skin felt like butter! Yes, I found my forever scrub and I’m on my way to getting everything else to treat me like the Queen that I am😁

avis.titre: Leaves face smooth and brightens skin
avis.texte: I have used this product for almost a year. My first time using, I thought the product was too harsh, but as soon as I washed it off my skin felt SMOOTH. Like new skin! I used it once (sometimes up to twice)a week and would gently scrub it on my face. Then after I pat dry I moisturize and massage skin jojoba oil. Definitely recommend !

My skin is sensitive/combination, I've tried Ole Henriksen Walnut powder scrub which costs much more than Acure but it hurted and dried my skin. Acure Brilliantly Brightening scrub caught my eyes because of the wonderful ingredients and decent price so I gave it a chance. I just wished I purchased it sooner coz the result is awesome ! My skin came out brighter, very smooth and fresh, no flakiness nor irritation. The exfoliating beads are just the right size to work effectively yet gentle. Plus, this product is cruelty free, highly recommend !

I bought this scrub based on all of the raving reviews... and I am SO glad that I did. I have used various scrubs on my face for the last 30 years and this is definitely the best I have come across. The off color doesn't bother me at all. The granules are very small, and yet they still work effectively. It's super easy to add this scrub to a beauty routines 2-3x/week. I highly recommend the product.

Like th I should very much. Relieved in Allure beauty box. One ounce size. Only takes a small amount to do whole face. Face felt tight and smooth. I have very large pores so this tightened and closed pores very well. Pleased and would recommend that you try. And the price is very reasonable. I do not spend a lot of money on beauty products so this is a good deal

This product seems very sketchy, I recommend buying it at a reliable source.
